name: inspira-confetti
blurb: Canvas confetti animation triggered programmatically or on click.
description: Wrapper component using canvas-confetti library that renders particles in configurable patterns. Includes ConfettiButton for immediate click-triggered celebrations.
use_when: Success screens, form submissions, celebrations, or moments needing celebratory feedback.
avoid_when: Animations that must respect prefers-reduced-motion, or high-frequency particle calls.
a11y: Canvas-rendered animation; semantic content via children prop. Button variant is keyboard-accessible.
